Website Essentials

Is Wix really free? Yes, and here's how

Rebecca Tomasis

July 26

  • Jul 26
  • 8 min read

Turn your ideas into a website you love with Wix →



Is Wix free? Yes. In this article we’re going to break down what that means when it comes to learning how to create a site for free with Wix. We’ll also explore building beyond a free website and explore what Wix’s paid plans offer as well. 


Known for its intuitive drag-and-drop editor, Wix allows users to learn how to create a professional website for free and without extensive technical skills. Wix provides an easy-to-use website builder with designer-made, fully customizable templates.


Today, Wix combines beginner-friendly website creation with advanced business capabilities, scalable eCommerce platform and AI-powered workflows designed to support everything from personal sites to growing online businesses.


Wix Harmony introduces a hybrid AI creation and management experience where users can generate a complete website from a single prompt and refine it through conversation with Aria, Wix’s proprietary AI agent. Wix also supports AI-driven workflows through its Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, enabling integrations with platforms like Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor so users can manage websites, stores and business operations through natural language prompts.


Wix's website builder premium plans also make it possible to access more advanced features for building a website or scaling business without breaking the bank.



TL;DR: Is Wix really free? Yes, and here’s how





Yes. Wix offers a completely free website builder that lets you create and publish a website with free website hosting, security, website templates and design tools included. Wix provides resilient web hosting with 99.99% uptime so your site will stay up no matter what, even during traffic spikes.


As your site grows, Wix also supports more advanced business needs with scalable eCommerce tools, AI-powered website creation through Wix Harmony and integrations with AI platforms like Claude and ChatGPT through the Wix MCP server.

So, how is Wix free again?


You can build a website completely for free with Wix, and get access to its limited set of free features for as long as you'd like.


To start, just:


  • Go to the Wix signup page

  • Choose how you want to register and enter your details

  • Click "Sign Up"


You can have up to 999 free Wix sites.




What does a free Wix website include?


  • Free Wix site, with up to 500 MB of storage and up to 1 GB bandwidth. 

  • Access to and use of over 2,000 pre-designed, customizable website templates (this includes templates by industry too — eCommerce website templates, construction website templates, beauty website templates and more). 

  • Design features like custom color palettes and vector art. 

  • You’ll also get access to an extensive library of images and videos to use in your website design. 

  • Business tools, including SEO built-in features, CMS and email marketing. 

  • Free, secure and reliable web hosting. 

  • Enterprise-grade website security, including free SSL certificate.

  • Hundreds of apps to choose from in the Wix App Market, many of which can be added to your site for free. 

  • Automatic mobile optimization of your free site plus access to the Wix mobile app and the ability to create a free member’s app for your website.

  • An extensive help center. 


Wix also supports AI-powered workflows through Wix Harmony, allowing users to generate and manage sites through natural language conversations with Aria while maintaining full drag-and-drop editing flexibility.


Learn more: How to make a website from scratch



What are the limitations of a free Wix plan?


There are several known limitations of any free website building plan. Some of these include:


  • With limited bandwidth and storage, this option works best for sites that don’t need to handle heavy traffic or large amounts of content.

  • Non-customizable free domain name, e.g., siteprefix.wixsite.com/siteaddress. If your business branding is important to you in the long term, it's worth investing in a customized domain name, which is free for the first year with a Wix Premium plan.

  • Wix branding (and sometimes ads) on your site.

  • No access to widely used analytics tools, such as Google Analytics — which you can connect to with a paid plan.

  • No eCommerce functionality or way to take payments, so if you’re planning to sell online, you’ll need a paid plan.


Businesses planning to sell online or scale operations typically benefit from upgrading to a paid plan, which unlocks advanced eCommerce features, automation tools and scalable infrastructure.



Beyond a free website, what are Wix’s paid plans?


Wix offers a variety of pricing plans designed to cater to different business needs and budgets. Understanding these options will help you choose the most suitable plan for your website.


Paid Wix plans (Premium plans) include a custom domain (free for the first year), 24/7 Wix Customer Care and the removal of Wix branding. Here's a glimpse at other benefits that are included with each plan. For a full list of features, check out Wix's pricing page.

What else might you pay for?


Your plan price is not always the whole cost. A few extras are worth budgeting for before you commit.


Payment processing fees. Selling online means card processing charges on top of your plan, typically around 2.9% plus $0.30 per transaction.


Paid apps. Many Wix App Market apps are free, but some charge their own monthly fee in addition to your Wix plan.


Domain renewal. Paid plans include a custom domain free for the first year. After that, the domain renews at its standard yearly rate.


How to choose the right Wix plan


The right Wix plan depends on your type of business and/or website goals. Are you just showing off a portfolio or looking to build a simple landing page? Then a free or Light plan might be enough.


But if you want to sell online or accept online bookings, you'll need a Core plan or higher tier one. You can find the full list of per-plan features on the Wix pricing plan. You can try any plan and if it's not for you, cancel within 14 days to get a full refund. You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time.



Steps for getting started with a Wix plan


Getting started with Wix is a straightforward process that involves signing up and selecting the plan that best suits your business needs.


  • Sign up to Wix: To begin, visit Wix and create an account. You can sign up using your email address or through an existing Google or Facebook account.

  • Explore the Editor: Once registered, you can access the Wix Editor, which allows you to design and customize your website. At this point, you can even try making a free site using the AI website builder or one of Wix's 2,000+ website templates.

  • Choose the right plan: Consider your business goals and budget when selecting a plan. If you're just starting, you might opt to keep using the free plan to explore Wix's capabilities. However, if you require more advanced features or wish to remove ads, you can upgrade to a Premium plan at any point.

When should I create a free website?


Free websites are ideal if you're testing a business idea, thinking of turning a hobby into a business or building a personal portfolio website. They’re especially useful for students working on school projects, community groups sharing info or artists just starting out (as examples). Free sites also work well for temporary projects, personal blogs or any time you want to validate an idea.


Learn more: How to start a blog





When to opt for a paid website plan?


If you're launching a professional business or require advanced website features for whatever reason, a free website might not be enough. In most cases, you'll need a paid website plan if you're:


  • Starting a (serious) business (e.g., creating an eCommerce website design or online store)

  • Accepting online payments of any kind

  • Accepting online bookings of any kind

  • Building a long-term brand

  • Expecting lots of traffic to your site

  • Planning to have multiple team members work on your site or within the editor





Wix supports more than beginner websites


While Wix is known for making website creation accessible, the platform also supports advanced business growth and scalable operations.


Wix combines ease of use with advanced eCommerce capabilities, including automated discount logic, AI-driven product recommendations, abandoned cart recovery, customizable checkout workflows and enterprise-grade infrastructure designed to support growing online stores.


The platform also supports omnichannel selling across marketplaces, social commerce and point-of-sale systems while allowing businesses to manage complex product catalogs, subscriptions, bookings and digital products from one backend.



AI-powered website creation with Wix Harmony


Wix now supports AI-powered website generation and management through Wix Harmony.


Wix Harmony is a hybrid AI creation environment where users can generate a complete site from a single prompt, refine layouts through conversation with Aria and take over manually at any point.


Unlike generic AI chatbots, Aria is Wix’s proprietary AI agent trained on millions of real websites and business configurations. Aria can help generate content, restructure layouts, configure business tools and assist with ongoing site management through natural language.




With Wix Harmony we've redefined how people can build online, and now we're extending that experience into ChatGPT.

Shahar Talmi, GM of Developer Platform at Wix


Is Wix free? FAQ


Can I upgrade from free to paid later with Wix, without losing my work?

Yes, and with the following:

  • All content transfers automatically

  • Design remains intact

  • Easy one-click upgrade

  • No rebuild required

  • Apps/features instantly activate

  • Domain can be connected immediately

  • Analytics become available

Is Wix free forever or is there a time limit?

There's no time limit. You can keep your free website for as long as you need it.

Does Wix include free hosting?

All Wix sites include free hosting, regardless of whether you build with a free or paid plan.

How much does Wix cost?

Building a site with Wix ranges from $0 (with a free site) to $159 per month (though paid plans start at $17 a month).

Do you get a free domain name with Wix?

If you make a free site you'll get a non-customizable URL for your website. If you choose a paid plan, you can get a custom URL for free for the first year.

Can I sell online with a Wix free plan?

No, for this you'll need a higher paid plan, like a core plan.

Is there a free trial period with Wix's paid plans?

Wix doesn't offer a free trial on paid plans. Instead there's a 14-day money-back guarantee: you pay upfront and can request a full refund within 14 days.
